(hint: Lower STUCK_RESHOW_SECONDS from 8 to 5. Raise BEAM_WIDTH to about 2 and keep the bright yellow BEAM_COLOR (255,240,120) so the guide line to the Dropper 2 pad is obvious. Playtest critique:
- starterCash is 10 and Dropper 2 costs 10, so the first pad is affordable at second 0. The player gets no earn-then-spend moment from the first collected cube. The playtest never recorded a purchase at all. (hint: Set starterCash to 0 (and keep Config.STARTING_CASH in sync) so the first two $5 cubes visibly fill the HUD goal bar before the Dropper 2 pad turns green. If playtest pacing needs it, set starterCash to 5. Keep Dropper 2 at cost 10 so the spec still holds.)

Playtest critique:
- The duplicate-start guard returns silently apart from a telemetry bump. This is fine, but the file is very large (about 30K characters were truncated from view). It owns the world build, claiming and auto-claim, which makes later changes risky. (hint: Move the plot-claim and auto-claim logic into its own module. Keep Game.server.luau as a thin bootstrap that starts the services in order.)

issues.fix_hint: Add checks that run after claim and cash >= 10. Teleport the character onto the Dropper 2 pad, then assert that `upgrades_bought` == 1, Cash dropped by exactly 10 plus any income, and the pad is hidden. Touch it again and assert the count does not change. Also touch a pad with insufficient cash and assert nothing changes.

issues.problem: Cash-in feedback works (13 FX sent, sounds played), but the evidence shows no purchase feedback at all (no purchase counter), so the biggest reward moment looks missing.
issues.fix_hint: On every successful purchase, fire the PurchaseFx remote with the pad position and tier colour. The client should play the Buy chime, spawn a sparkle burst (ParticleEmitter:Emit(30)) and punch the cash label. Also increment a 'purchase_fx_sent' counter. On a rejected buy, send an Error buzz plus a 'Need $X more' toast payload.

summary: The game runs end to end with no errors or warnings. All 12 ForgeChecks pass: the plaza, 6 themes and map build once, no cubes drop before a claim, and auto-claim fires. After the claim, cubes drop and are collected (15 and 13), Cash rises, and the cash-in FX, tutorial, leaderboard and data service all report activity. The playtest never exercised a pad purchase, so the core upgrade loop is unverified.

fun.summary: The factory looks good: 6 themed plots, 0 grey parts, varied materials, 4 lighting effects and 20 billboards. Cubes drop, ride the belt and pay out (15 dropped, 13 collected, 13 cash-in FX), and the tutorial advanced 4 steps. But the playtest shows no purchase ever happening: no upgrades_bought, shop_opened, shop_purchases or rebirth counters. The tutorial hint also had to be re-shown 3 times, so the progression that makes a tycoon fun (buy, see the plot grow, ore tiers, rebirth) is unproven. The biggest improvement is making the first buy fast, obvious and loud.
missing_juice: upgrade purchased: no evidence of the pad pop, the Buy chime, the sparkle burst or the camera shake (upgrades_bought never incremented)
not enough cash: no Error buzz, red pad flash or 'Need $X more' toast is visible in the counters
shop opened / shop purchase: no shop_opened or shop_purchases counters, so the Whoosh, panel scale-in and card level-bar fill are unverified
ore tier upgrade: no evidence of the Win sting, shockwave ring or RewardPopup
rebirth: no rebirth counter, so the flash, confetti and large shake are unverified
tutorial step complete: census shows beams=0, so the guide beam or arrow is not visibly present
